title: A remote attacker who knows a valid account's enrolled SSH public key can terminate the shared SSH service in Progress…
description: A vulnerability in Progress Software WS_FTP Server on Windows allows a remote attacker who knows a valid account's enrolled SSH public key to terminate the shared SSH service. This affects versions prior to 2024.0.7 and 2025.0.4. The vulnerability has a high severity score and impacts availability without affecting confidentiality or integrity.
